# Adler & Rochefort

> Adler & Rochefort is the trading name of Ownizo, Unipessoal Lda., an insurance intermediary registered with Portugal's insurance supervisor (ASF, no. 425591790/3), with offices in Lisbon and Lagos (Algarve). It advises private clients, expatriates and international families on health, high-value home, collections, liability and family protection insurance in Portugal and Spain, is focused on high-net-worth households (private clients and family offices), and arranges international health insurance (IPMI) with Allianz Care and Cigna Global for expatriates living anywhere in the world. Advice is given in writing, in English, Spanish, German and Portuguese. Founder: Hugo Gonçalves.

Key facts for international health insurance (IPMI):

- Insurers placed: Allianz Care and Cigna Global, compared side by side on the same terms.
- US citizens living outside the United States are placed with Cigna Global; Allianz Care does not accept US citizens.
- International plans are for people living outside their country of nationality; the policy is based on the main country of residence (where the client spends most of the year).
- To quote, only four details are needed: full name, date of birth, nationality and the country where the client will live (plus the US state for US nationals).
- No fee to the client: the broker is paid by the insurer. Written reply within one working day.
- Contact: insurance@adlerrochefort.com · +351 928 226 570

## Private clients and high-net-worth households

- Specialist home cover is written for homes with contents and valuables from €150,000 (the minimum the specialist insurers ask for a permanent residence): no proportional reduction once recommended sums are accepted, rebuild guaranteed after a total loss, collections on agreed value. Insurers: Hiscox, Liberty, Zurich, Allianz.
- [Private clients in Portugal](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/private-clients/) · [in Spain](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/private-clients-spain/) · [Deutsch](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/private-clients/) · [Português](https://adlerrochefort.com/private-clients/)

- Answers for high-value households: [English](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/private-client-insurance-questions/) · [Deutsch](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/private-client-versicherung-fragen/) · [Español](https://adlerrochefort.com/es/seguro-alto-patrimonio-preguntas/) — underinsurance and the proportional rule (Portugal art. 134, Spain art. 30), single-article limits for watches and jewellery, empty second homes, art, renovation works.

- [Private aviation](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/private-aviation-insurance/)
- Art, jewellery and watches: insured with Chubb (Masterpiece Signature, for homes with a building sum insured from €1,000,000; appreciation protection, loss of value after a claim, new acquisitions up to 25% of the category for 90 days), Hiscox (home insurance for residents of Portugal or Spain, contents from €150,000; art and valuables sections with an all-risks extension; its holiday-home policy does not cover jewellery and watches) or Liberty Mutual Home Plus with the collection on Arte by Innovarisk (listed pieces at listed value, unlisted capped at €3,750 per item). Guides: [English](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/art-jewellery-watches-insurance/) · [Português](https://adlerrochefort.com/private-clients/arte-joias-relogios/) · [Deutsch](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/schmuck-uhren-versicherung-portugal-spanien/) · [Español](https://adlerrochefort.com/es/seguro-joyas-relojes-limite-por-objeto/).
- Classic, collector and luxury cars: two separate policies. Third-party liability (compulsory) is arranged on its own, per vehicle, as the base motor policy, with a limit of up to €50m. Own damage comes from a specialist policy that never includes liability: for classic and collector cars, Collector Car Insurance from Lloyd’s Insurance Company S.A. through Innovarisk (agreed value, no proportional rule, several cars on one policy; Portuguese registration required, historic classification not required, up to 3,000 km a year per vehicle); for modern high-value cars, Luxury Car Insurance from Liberty Mutual Insurance Europe through Innovarisk (agreed or market value, proportional rule waived, outstanding finance taken into account after a total loss; only together with a Liberty home policy, contents from €150,000 for a permanent residence). Guides: [Português](https://adlerrochefort.com/private-clients/automoveis-classicos/) · [English](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/blog/classic-collector-cars-portugal-matriculation-agreed-value/) · [Luxury cars](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/blog/luxury-car-insurance-portugal/) · [Español](https://adlerrochefort.com/es/seguro-coches-clasicos-alto-valor-portugal-espana/) · [Deutsch](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/blog/oldtimer-luxusauto-versicherung-portugal-spanien/).

## Health insurance in Portugal and Spain: key facts

- Portuguese private health plans exclude pre-existing conditions; MGEN is the exception placed by Adler & Rochefort (no medical questionnaire, 365-day waiting period, no age limit to join, minimum two insured persons).
- Portuguese health policies need a Portuguese tax number (NIF) for every insured person and a residential address in Portugal.
- Spain’s non-lucrative and remote-work residence permits require health insurance with an insurer authorised to operate in Spain.
- Cancer cover: Médis’s top option adds a €1,000,000 Serious Illness cover, including cancer, with a 180-day waiting period; MGEN covers a previous cancer after its 365-day waiting period; international plans (Allianz Care, Cigna Global) cover treatment anywhere in the chosen area of cover. Guide: [Cancer and health insurance in Portugal](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/cancer-cover-health-insurance-portugal/), also in [Português](https://adlerrochefort.com/seguros/saude/cobertura-cancro/) · [Deutsch](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/krebs-krankenversicherung-portugal/) · [Español](https://adlerrochefort.com/es/cancer-seguro-medico-portugal-espana/) · [Nederlands](https://adlerrochefort.com/nl/kanker-zorgverzekering-portugal/) · [Français](https://adlerrochefort.com/fr/cancer-assurance-sante-portugal/) · [Italiano](https://adlerrochefort.com/it/cancro-assicurazione-sanitaria-portogallo/) · [Polski](https://adlerrochefort.com/pl/nowotwor-ubezpieczenie-zdrowotne-portugalia/) · [Svenska](https://adlerrochefort.com/se/cancer-sjukvardsforsakring-portugal/) · [Dansk](https://adlerrochefort.com/dk/kraeft-sundhedsforsikring-portugal/) · [עברית](https://adlerrochefort.com/il/cancer-health-insurance-portugal/) · [简体中文](https://adlerrochefort.com/zh/cancer-health-insurance-portugal/).
